title: 442 East Royal Fern Way Vacation Rental
meta_description: 442 East Royal Fern Way is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:- WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pool Passes Included in Rental (Maximum allotted wristband qty is 10)- 6-Seater Street Legal Golf Cart- 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental- Private Pool with Spa (complimentary pool heating available October 1-May 1)- Propane Grill- Parking for 2 Vehicles (Garage Access Not Available)- 6 Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor- 8 Minute Golf Cart Ride to WaterColor's Beach Club Access- 7 Minute Golf Cart Ride to Seaside DETAILS: Step into paradise at 442 East Royal Fern Way, an exquisite 5-bedroom retreat in WaterColor Crossing. This professionally decorated home boasts a private pool, hot tub, spacious outdoor area, and a new 6-seater electric cart to whisk you to nearby beaches and attractions. Inside, soothing tones, hardwood floors, and an airy open floor plan create an inviting space. The chef’s kitchen dazzles with its oversized island, Wolf and Subzero appliances, and marble herringbone backsplash, flowing seamlessly into a cozy living area complete with a wet bar, ice maker, and wine fridge. The adjoining dining area and screened porch overlook the pool, filling the space with natural light. On the main floor, the luxurious master suite offers a king bed, double vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. A second king bedroom with a private bath and a laundry room complete this level. Upstairs, two queen bedrooms with ensuite baths, a bunk room, and a media room with leather recliners make for a perfect escape. With six adult bikes and a golf cart included, you can easily explore Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and 30A’s coastal treasures. Let Sanders Beach Rentals make your dream vacation a reality at 442 East Royal Fern Way, where every detail inspires relaxation and adventure.
